items.title: Citi CEO Looks Forward to Working With Sen. Warren
items.summary: Citigroup Inc. Chief Executive Officer Jane Fraser says she is ready to work with Senator Elizabeth Warren, a Democrat from Massachusetts, who has been critical of the bank. She speaks to Lisa Abramowicz at a Bloomberg Newsmakers event in Washington.

items.title: Citi CEO Expects More Tech Outages
items.summary: Citigroup Inc. Chief Executive Officer Jane Fraser says she is not surprised by recent tech outages across the US. She says an enormous amount of tech patches are being rolled out. She speaks to Lisa Abramowicz at a Bloomberg Newsmakers event in Washington.

items.title: 5 Banks With Dependable Passive Income Dividends That Could Prosper as Rates Rise
items.summary: Every one of these five bank stocks slashed its dividend in the financial crisis, yet a new rate cycle may be rewarding patient holders. Only one has stopped raising its payout, and another carries a hidden capital risk worth knowing about.

items.title: JPMorgan Names New CFO: Is Jamie Dimon's Succession Plan Taking Shape?
items.summary: JPM names Bregje de Best as its next CFO, marking another leadership shift as the bank strengthens its succession pipeline ahead of Jamie Dimon's eventual exit.
